blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) will request an Interpol Red Notice against Batangas 1st. District Rep. Leandro Leviste, who is reportedly in Germany, after an arrest warrant was issued against him. READ: Makati RTC orders arrest of Leandro Leviste “Apply-an na namin sa Philippine Center on Transnational Crimes para makakuha ng Red Notice,” Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla said in an ambush interview on Wednesday. (We will apply through the Philippine Center on Transnational Crimes to obtain a Red Notice.) Remulla also said that Leviste may be in Germany.
